# Sky Frontend (sky-f)

> This file is intended for Large Language Models (LLMs) to quickly understand the structure, context, and key contents of the sky-f project.

## About
Sky is a frontend application built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Vuex, Vue Router, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, and PixiJS.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Vue 3 (Composition API / Class Components)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **State Management**: Vuex 4
- **Routing**: Vue Router 4
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, SCSS, PostCSS
- **Animations/Graphics**: GSAP, PixiJS
- **Media**: hls.js (Video streaming), jspdf (PDF generation)
- **HTTP Client**: Axios

## Project Structure
- `/public`: Static assets (SVG icons, HTML templates, images, manifest).
- `/src/components`: Reusable UI Vue components.
- `/src/views`: Main page views.
- `/src/store`: Vuex state management modules.
- `/src/router`: Vue Router configurations.
- `/src/http-client`: Axios configurations and API wrappers.
- `/src/utils`: Helper functions and utilities.
- `/src/assets`: Compiled assets and global styles.

## Developer Commands
- `npm run serve`: Start local development server
- `npm run build`: Build for production
- `npm run lint`: Lint source files

## Important Links
- [Vue.js Documentation](https://vuejs.org/)
- [Tailwind CSS Documentation](https://tailwindcss.com/)
